points: Built and scaled the Voice AI platform behind 1M+ conversation minutes, supporting real-time AI phone agents across healthcare, recruiting, customer support, and business automation use cases.
Owned the entire voice stack end-to-end (Telephony → SIP → STT → LLM → TTS → Workflow Engine), optimizing for 300–500ms response latency, reliability, and production-scale deployments.

Designed resilient voice pipelines with intelligent retries, failover mechanisms, interruption handling, and queue orchestration, supporting thousands of concurrent calls and workflows across customer deployments.

Built and maintained telephony infrastructure across Twilio, Plivo, 382 Communications, and Jambonz — including SIP trunking, carrier routing, call bridging, and real-time media streaming — using multi-carrier optimization and intelligent routing to reduce per-minute telephony costs.

Shipped core Voice AI capabilities including warm transfers, agent-to-agent handoffs, IVR/DTMF navigation, voicemail detection, outbound campaigns, SMS workflows, call evaluations, compliance systems, and configurable automation flows.

Built enterprise knowledge systems combining web crawling, sitemap ingestion, PDF processing, vector indexing, and semantic retrieval pipelines, significantly improving answer quality and reducing hallucinations in production environments.
Delivered integrations across CRM, ATS, scheduling, and business systems through configurable APIs, OAuth2 authentication, and workflow automation.
Drove core platform capabilities that helped scale customer adoption by 3×, while maintaining 99.9%+ platform availability and low-latency conversational performance.

Built a Notion-like editor using Tiptap.js with 15+ custom nodes (AI block, tabs, comments, expandable sections, media, mentions), improving documentation interactivity and reducing manual formatting effort.

Engineered AI-powered documentation generation by integrating OpenAI APIs with FastAPI microservices, enabling real-time code-to-doc streaming from GitHub repos and cutting documentation time for dev teams by 90%.
Developed a Kanban board fully synced with GitHub issues via webhooks, supporting assignments, labels, filters, sorting, and search, improving project visibility and reducing context switching.

Designed backend architecture with Firebase schema + Cloud Functions and created a parser service to transform AI output streams into structured editor nodes, improving scalability and reducing processing errors
Integrated Electron.js IPC for Git/file synchronization, ensuring offline-first editing with seamless remote repo sync, which boosted workflow reliability
Designed UI/UX in Figma and developed a dashboard with GitHub stats, commit history, and animations using Framer Motion, enhancing usability and engagement.
Collaborated with the founding team to identify technical challenges and shape product roadmaps, contributing to feature decisions across the stack.

Built a responsive, visually rich client website using Next.js and MongoDB, featuring a beta registration flow that helped onboard early users and increase session time by 40%, based on internal analytics.
Developed core components for the client’s React Native app, accelerating early-stage mobile development and ensuring consistent UI/UX across platforms.
Created a complete payment and certification automation flow using PayPal, Stripe, and Razorpay, achieving a 99% success rate in transactions and eliminating 100% of manual certificate handling.
Built and optimized core APIs for e-commerce features including reels, posts, products, comments, reviews, and users,handling 10,000+ daily requests.
Built real-time messaging and notification features using WebSockets, supporting 5,000+ concurrent users.
Built scalable backend logic and database operations with Express.js and MongoDB, improving API response speed by 45% for high-traffic endpoints.
